node.title: H3 quotient-orbit canonical resultant manifest
node.statement: Every odd-Galois quotient block at n=2^s has a unique canonical identifier (j,+,w), with w nonunit or a nonidentity odd unit modulo 2^(j+1), or (j,-,w), with w nonzero even. Its monic irreducible orbit polynomial is the explicit cyclotomic resultant Res(Phi_L,T-S_w), or the power-of-two-normalized reciprocal resultant. This generates all 3(n-s-1) block polynomials without orbit enumeration. It does not identify support across reciprocal blocks, compute official-scale resultants or annihilators, reduce total degree, prove a runtime bound, or close C36'.
